facts.label: Reflexivos em convites
facts.sub: Help yourself! Enjoy yourself! I made it myself. Sujeito e objeto são a mesma pessoa, então o pronome muda: myself, yourself, himself, herself, themselves.

facts.label: Sirva-se
facts.sub: Use help yourself quando oferece comida ou bebida a uma pessoa: Help yourself to some casserole. Para várias pessoas, diga help yourselves. É muito comum em jantares e festas nos Estados Unidos.

facts.label: Divirta-se
facts.sub: Use enjoy yourself para desejar que alguém se divirta: Enjoy yourself at the party! Contando sobre você, diga I enjoyed myself. O verbo enjoy pede o pronome reflexivo quando não há outro objeto.

pages.title: A warm dinner · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a freezing Saturday evening in Minneapolis. Eli lives in a small apartment near the river. A tray of warm bread sits near the door. His friend Rui arrives with a red scarf. Eli cooked the whole dinner himself. He wants Rui to feel at home.

“Rui, welcome! Please help yourself to some casserole.” says Eli. “Thanks, Eli. It smells great. Did you make it yourself?” says Rui. “Yes, I made it myself, and my sister made the dessert herself.” says Eli.
